heuristics: Canonicalized parallel rho walk modeled as a uniform random function on an m=r/2-element set.
The 10% escape-rate bound is empirically supported (measured 4.07% on the toy construction with matching branch count and automorphism structure), not a proven worst case.
The chaining table's O(1)-expected traversal cost is a standard balls-into-bins expectation argument, not a deterministic worst-case guarantee.
limitations: M_p256=300 instructions/field-mult is an unpinned analytic upper-bound estimate.
Analytic construction; no full-size execution. experiment.py exercises the exact production mechanism (including the doubling escape) on a toy additive exponent group.
Success probability targets 0.40 with explicit margin over the 0.39 floor.
